title: ACI source record
description: One row = one source for one incident. THE RULE: a source must be checkable later, so it needs a URL or a filed capture. Gated sources (paywalled, blocked, print, broadcast) require a filed capture. See docs/source-archiving.md.

url.description: Live link. Optional ONLY if captured_file is present.

archive_url.description: Wayback snapshot URL (web.archive.org/web/...). Strongly expected for any live web source.

captured_file.description: Path under captures/, e.g. captures/S0037_2026-11-02_scan.jpg. Required when access is not 'public'.

tier.description: A=primary record; B=official dataset; C=two independent contemporaneous news; D=single news; E=secondary compilation (never publishable)

allOf.description: URL or capture — one of the two is mandatory
